requirements:
ray[serve,tune,rllib]
requests
comet_ml
pytest
aws_requests_auth
pyyaml
boto3
dockerfile:
FROM python:3.9-slim

WORKDIR /app

COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt

COPY . .

CMD ["python", "-c", "import ray; ray.init()"]
explanation: Requirements include core Ray with common extras (serve,tune,rllib) plus detected imports. Dockerfile uses slim Python 3.9 base, installs requirements efficiently, and provides a minimal Ray startup command as default.
